title: IFB Repairs for 553-A Pinecrest Cir. - Municipal Housing

onscreen_lines.desc: SUMMARY The purpose of this project is to provide complete installation of new 12" x 12" ceramic floor tile throughout the applicable interior areas of the unit. The work shall include approximately 1,350 square feet of floor area, including four bedrooms, two bathrooms, living room, kitchen, dining area, hallways, closets, pantries, and any other interior area requiring ceramic floor tile installation. The Contractor shall provide all labor, tools, equipment, supervision, preparation, installation, finishing, and cleanup necessary for a complete and professional ceramic tile flooring installation. Municipal Housing will provide all required materials for the project. Property located at 553-A Pinecrest Cir., Laredo, Texas 78041. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS All work shall comply with the Department of Community Development /Municipal Housing general requirements. Work specifications shall comply with all building codes currently adopted by City of Laredo. Contractor shall keep job site clean, safe, and in an orderly manner. Contractor will be solely responsible for obtaining and paying for all required city permits, requests for construction progress inspections, and final inspections of this project. Contractor shall familiarize himself/herself with the scope of the project, existing conditions, and proposed improvements to the project. No additional compensation will be given to the Contractor for failure to visit the job site and familiarize himself/herself with the project as noted above. The Contractor is responsible for the project location as well as his workforce, subcontractors, and all others associated with the work to be performed on the project. The Contractor shall furnish all new materials, where required, which are to match existing materials in size, thickness, texture, finish, design, and value. The Contractor shall be responsible for any damages caused to the Owner’s property during the construction operations. The contractor shall make sure that all existing items and systems in the home, and improvements to be made, are in complete working order upon completion of the project. The Contractor shall provide all necessary labor, materials, and equipment to complete this project. The contractor shall provide a written warranty of one year on all materials and workmanship to the Owner and to the Community Development Department / Municipal Housing upon completion of project. Contractor shall provide all required color samples to the Owner for selection. TEMPORARY SERVICES Contractor shall provide a portable toilet and trash dumpster/dump truck at the job site prior to starting the project. Failure to provide these services, will result in a change order credit towards the Homeowner, as determined by Community Development / Municipal Housing. REMOVE EXISTING ITEMS All items removed shall be properly disposed of, remove from site, and hauled to the City of Laredo landfill on a weekly basis by contractor. CERAMIC FLOOR TILE INSTALLATION The Contractor shall be responsible for the complete installation of 12" x 12" ceramic floor tile throughout the unit. • Prepare the existing floor surfaces as necessary to receive the new ceramic tile, including removal of loose, damaged, or unsuitable flooring materials where applicable. Concrete chip required for better tile adhesion. Verify that the floor surface is adequately prepared, reasonably level, clean, dry, and suitable for ceramic tile installation before beginning installation. Install 12" x 12" ceramic floor tile in approximately 1,350 square feet of floor area. Install ceramic tile in all applicable areas of the unit, including four bedrooms, two bathrooms, living room, kitchen, dining area, hallways, closets, pantries, and any other area requiring ceramic flooring. Provide all necessary cuts, fitting, alignment, transitions, and adjustments around walls, doorways, closets, cabinets, plumbing fixtures, and other permanent conditions. Maintain consistent tile alignment, spacing, layout, and appearance throughout the installation. Install appropriate grout in all tile joints and complete all necessary finishing and sealing work associated with the installation. Install new 1x4 baseboard/zoclo throughout the entire unit. The Contractor shall measure, cut, fit, install, and properly finish the baseboard in all applicable areas. Properly install and finish baseboard at corners, transitions, door openings, closets, and other locations necessary to provide a complete finished appearance. Protect walls, doors, cabinets, fixtures, and other existing property during the work and repair any damage caused by the Contractor. Complete all necessary detail work to provide a finished, safe, durable, and professional ceramic tile floor installation. MATERIALS PROVIDED BY MUNICIPAL HOUSING City of Laredo Municipal Housing will provide all required materials for the project, including the ceramic tile and other materials designated by Municipal Housing. The Contractor shall be responsible for receiving, handling, protecting, transporting within the work area, and properly installing the materials provided. WARRANTY The contractor shall provide a written one-year warranty on all materials and workmanship to the owner and to the Department of Community Development/ Municipal Housing upon completion of the project. TURN OVER OF PROJECT Before turning over project to the Owner and to the Municipal Housing, Contractor shall ensure that the property and home are clean and free of debris. The entire project shall be turned over in a clean, professional, and functional manner. Provide all necessary grounds maintenance to remove all unnecessary vegetation, trees, trim trees and yard maintenance. TIME SCHEDULE Contractor shall have 15 calendar days to complete the project in its entirety.
